about: Session scenarios (core §5.2, §6, §9) of the example probe of confirm.json (boot_id 0x12345678). Each scenario starts from its initial state; the steps are sent in order on one transport, each answered before the next. Remaining times are shown as if no time had passed between the steps: a real probe answers the time actually left. S = 0x11223344, T = 0x55667788.

scenarios.name: end releases the session; its id is then no_session, and a resent end is answered from the table
scenarios.initial: lock free, no session has held it since boot

steps.note: open S, lease 2000 ms, no force
end of S: the lock and everything S created are released
the same end resent with the same corr: the remembered answer, nothing executed
a new request with S: no session holds the lock

scenarios.name: another session while the lock is held, then force

steps.note: open T without force: locked, the remaining time (as if no time had passed) and the owner
open T with force: S's resources are released, T holds the lock
keepalive of S: locked (T holds it; T's open gave no owner)
keepalive with session_id 0: an op that requires the lock
the same open resent (open is not looked up in the table): the lease restarts, nothing is released
lock_state with session_id 0: held, the remaining time as if no time had passed
